text: 220 V DC system: two batteries 2 x 100 % with two chargers (00BTA10), two DC bus sections (00BRA20). Battery sizing (ALP-EPC-00000-EL-CAL-0002) shall provide 2 hours of autonomy for the continuous DC load and 30 minutes for the emergency DC oil pumps of the GT and ST at the end of the period, with an ageing factor of 1.25, a temperature factor of 1.1 and the lowest electrolyte temperature of the battery room design. The chargers shall supply the continuous load and recharge the battery within 10 hours.
